newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz sales rep in fraud probe.
newsitem.headline: Allianz sales rep in fraud probe.

text.p: Allianz AG Holding, Europe's largest insurer, on Thursday said German police were investigating one of its sales representatives for alleged fraud and embezzlement.
Police said separately that they were responding to a complaint filed by an Allianz client.
The accused rep allegedly used Allianz's official business stationery for "private business deals", Allianz spokesman Wolfgang Heilmann told Reuters in response to a query.
The man had borrowed money from clients and promised repayments at unusually high interest rates.
Heilmann said the man was a long-term employee of the giant insurance group. Losses to Allianz are estimated at a single digit million mark sum.
